articleTitle: Prediction of Crop Recommendation Technique Using Supervised Machine Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of a machine learning-based crop recommendation system using soil composition data. Through extensive exploratory data analysis (EDA), key soil parameters-such as temperature, humidity, nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium levels-are identified as crucial for optimal crop growth. The dataset is thoroughly analyzed to determine crop-specific requirements, and several machine learning models, including K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, are trained and evaluated. Among these models, the Random Forest Classifier achieved the highest accuracy, with 99.59%, in predicting the most suitable crop for given soil conditions. For instance, the model recommends approximately 70mm of rainfall for optimal rice growth. The results demonstrate a robust model capable of generalizing well across various soil compositions, offering a valuable tool for precision agriculture. This predictive system provides farmers with a reliable and efficient method to optimize crop yield, supporting sustainable farming practices. The study successfully meets its objectives, with minimal deviations, and sets the stage for future advancements in AI-driven smart agriculture solutions.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Support Vector Machine and Convolutional Neural Network for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The rapid growth of image classification tasks in various applications, from facial recognition to object detection, highlights the importance of developing efficient and accurate classification techniques. In particular, distinguishing between visually similar categories, such as dogs and cats, presents unique challenges due to the subtle differences in features like fur texture, facial structure, and posture. In this paper, we compare two distinct approaches for the binary classification of dog and cat images: a traditional machine learning technique and a deep learning method. The first approach involves feature extraction using Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) followed by classification with a Support Vector Machine (SVM). The second approach employs a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a deep learning architecture known for its ability to automatically learn hierarchical features from image data. Our primary objective is to evaluate and analyze the performance of these two methods in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and overall effectiveness. Experimental results demonstrate that the CNN model significantly outperforms the traditional machine learning approach, achieving higher classification accuracy and superior feature extraction without manual intervention. These findings emphasize the growing importance of CNNs for image-based classification problems, as they demonstrate higher performance and flexibility over conventional machine learning models.

articleTitle: Leveraging Deep Learning for Fever Temperature Analysis and Pattern Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Tympanic temperature is one of the most fundamental indicators for the diagnosis of diseases. Due to its importance, using patients' temperature data to aid in the diagnostic process would be beneficial. This work uses temperature data collected from various patients to classify diseases. We consider dengue, tuberculosis, and non-infectious and non-tubercular bacterial diseases. Extracting essential features from the temperature data is necessary so that the downstream layers only have to consider important features, not miscellaneous information. This feature extraction is done using two methods - Convolution Neural Networks and Autoencoders. We introduce three models for Explainable Temperature Analysis - ExTemp-Conv-SM, ExTemp-Conv-LG and ExTemp-Auto. We achieve a classification accuracy of 70% over these four disease classes. We also use explainable AI tools, like GradCAM, to identify distinguishing patterns in temperature fluctuations that can characterize diseases. We generate such patterns for all four diseases under consideration. We note that the patterns generated for dengue and tuberculosis match the findings in biological observation studies. We hope that the methods in this paper can be leveraged for other diseases and used to aid the diagnostic process.

articleTitle: Open-Source Tools for Undergraduate Education: Democratizing IC Design Using EDA
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The paper explores the application of open-source tools in integrated circuit (IC) design, focusing on the Skywater Process Development Kit (PDK) and its role in transforming the design process from Register Transfer Level (RTL) to Graphic Design System (GDS). It evaluates the practicality of using open-source software like Xschem, Ngspice, and Magic to simulate, layout, and validate an inverter circuit, ultimately demonstrating their cost-effectiveness and flexibility in real-world IC fabrication.

articleTitle: Influence of high e-Mobility Substrates on Performance of n-MOSFETs: A Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This research work focusses on studying the effect of high e-mobility substrate on n-MOSFET parameters like output characteristics, transfer characteristics, threshold voltage and transconductance. COMSOL Multiphysics simulation tool is used to design and simulate the model. Si, InP, Ge, GaAs, GaP are used as substrates for designing n-MOSFET. From the output characteristics of n-MOSFET with above-mentioned substrates the drain currents of n-MOSFET increases with change is substrate materials for a given value of gate voltage. GaAs substrate has shown significant improvement in drain current. Furthermore, it can be seen from transfer characteristics that the transconductance of n-MOSFET increases as the substrate changes in the order Si, GaP, GaAs, Ge, and InP, with Si showing 1.25 (μA/V) and InP showing 4.4 (μ A/V) Our results show the potential application of n-MOSFETs with substrates showing higher transconductance in RF circuits and audio amplifiers due to their increased amplification capacities.

articleTitle: Catalyzing Epilepsy Detection: A Deep Learning Approach with LSTM Networks for EEG Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Epilepsy is a prevalent neurological disorder, affecting around 50 million people globally. Detecting it accurately and promptly is crucial for effective patient care. However, traditional methods often find this challenging due to the complex and variable nature of EEG patterns in epilepsy. Our study introduces a groundbreaking approach that leverages deep learning, particularly LSTM networks, to address this challenge. LSTM networks excel at capturing long-term dependencies in sequential data, which makes them particularly suitable for analyzing EEG signals, which are essentially time-series data. Our work rigorously trained and evaluated LSTM model to distinguish epileptic form and non-epileptic brain activity. After extensive testing and cross-validation, our model detected epilepsy with 90% accuracy. The findings demonstrate that LSTM networks may accurately diagnose epilepsy and improve patient treatment and management. This epilepsy detection breakthrough could improve the lives of millions suffering by this neurological illness.

articleTitle: Papertronics: A Sustainable Interdisciplinary Approach Towards Smart Cities and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: In this paper, a methodology to design and develop basic circuit components to reduce electronic waste and utilize renewable materials in the context of sustainable development is proposed. This utilizes an innovative approach of pen-on-paper-based dynamically tunable flexible electrical components, which provides flexibility to develop basic circuit components of user-defined values. The basic components, such as resistors, capacitors, and transistors are developed on a paper substrate using a graphite pencil, and corresponding performance analysis is carried out. Finally, a paper-based capacitive touch sensor is also proposed for human-machine interaction. These devices can not only be used as sensors, but they also find their applications in wearable security solutions and smart access control systems to elevate safety and protection in smart cities.

articleTitle: PicMaker: A Text to Image Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: PicMaker introduces a pioneering framework for generating images from text, focusing on the CUB (Caltech-UCSD Birds) dataset and the AttnGAN (Attention Generative Adversarial Network) model. By utilizing the detailed annotations and varied bird images in CUB, the framework excels in producing high-quality bird images based on textual descriptions. Tailoring AttnGAN specifically for the CUB dataset enhances image quality, coherence, and diversity significantly. Through extensive experimentation and evaluation, PicMaker proves its efficacy in creating lifelike bird images from text. The assessment comprises quantitative and qualitative analysis, comparing the generated images with ground truth images and existing futuristic methods to assess their standard and realism.

articleTitle: VADATI: Sign to Speech Conversion Glove
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This project focuses on developing a glove designed to interpret sign language gestures and convert them into spoken words. Previous research in this area has led to the creation of various wearable devices using sensors and microcontrollers. The primary challenge addressed by this project is enhancing the accuracy and usability of the glove to include many hand signs. The methodology involves integrating flex sensors and an accelerometer with an Arduino microcontroller. The glove reads finger movements and hand orientations, translating these into speech using predefined algorithms. Future work will focus on expanding the vocabulary of recognized gestures and improving system robustness. Practical applications include educational tools, customer service enhancements, and broader accessibility in public spaces.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Various Antenna Substrates for Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: A performance comparison of brain tumor detection using different antenna substrate materials, such as natural rubber and silicon rubber substrates, is highlighted here. This paper analyzes the impact of these substrates on the designed microstrip patch antenna. Substrates made of silicon and natural rubber with the same relative permittivity were considered for the analysis. To improve performance of the antenna, a ground plane having circular Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) is provided and is simulated through HFSS software. The proposed antenna measured and compared the gain, return loss, and specific absorption rate (SAR) of these materials.

articleTitle: Synchronized Data Storage Based on Block Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: One of the best ways to store large amounts of data is through cloud storage; yet, centralized storage cloud computing lacks security. Block chain, on the other hand, is a decentralized cloud storage technology that guarantees data security. To maximize resource usage, any internet-connected computing node can join and create a peer network. Block chain is an immutable distributed peer-to-peer system because every node in the network keeps a copy of the block chain. The user's file is encrypted and saved using the IPFS (Interplanetary File System) protocol across several peers in the network's recommended system. IPFS is the source of hashes. The hash value, which is stored on the block chain, indicates the file path. The primary objectives of this project are high data availability, decentralized secure data storage, and efficient use of storage resources. A high degree of data security can be attained by encrypting the data and distributing it among several nodes, which addresses the security and privacy concerns associated with centralized cloud storage. This article introduces a block chain-based approach to identity management, addressing the urgent problems with conventional identification systems. By utilizing the decentralized and unchangeable characteristics of block chain technology, our solution guarantees a transparent and safe approach to handling digital identities. The identity of every user, including login credentials from other platforms, is encrypted and saved in block chain-based smart contracts. Users can access their saved data after being authenticated by signature-based verification methods. Decentralized architecture promotes user empowerment and privacy control in addition to improving security. This article uses an inventive integration of block chain technology to drive identity management into a new era, focusing on security, transparency, and user-centricity.

articleTitle: Data Driven Approach in Building Consumer-Friendly Business Models Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This study is about analyzing real-time data sets regarding customer issues, sub-issues, complaint received and company response through machine learning techniques. The central aim is to generate the effective prediction model to resolve the company customer satisfactory model. Model prediction is performed on supervised logistic regression, random forest and extreme gradient boosting techniques based on the data complexity. Performance metric like accuracy, F1 score, R2 value and root mean square error are observed for better accuracy of the model. Train and test case metrics are observed for better predictive model. Among all three mentioned models it is observed that Random Forest is performing better from their metrics like accuracy of 81.61%, -0.104 R2 values, 0.482 root mean square error and 0.280 F1 score values which almost near to train case 81.63, -0.098, 0.482,0.289 respectively. The proposed models are performance is acceptable range due to its complexity of the data set. More powerful techniques with better computational facilities is need of the hour for future Artificial intelligence applications.

articleTitle: Low-Level Signal Amplification using Quadruple MOSFET -BJT configuration
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper presents a novel narrow-band amplifier model designed to amplify small signal inputs effectively. These signal amplifications are required in audio range signal excursions and in several robotic applications where high voltage and current gains are required. The design and analysis comprehensively examine small signals, providing detailed insights into the circuit's behavior and performance characteristics. The proposed amplifier employs a complex arrangement of two MOSFETs and two BJTs in a quadruple configuration. It aims to magnify input signals ranging from 1-10mV with remarkable performance metrics. The amplifier achieves a maximum voltage gain of 353.08 and a current gain of 2.309K within a frequency range of 144.47kHz.

articleTitle: Early Prediction of Diabetes Using Transformer Based Ensemble Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Diabetes is managed in its early stages by employing transformer-based ensemble models for early diabetes prediction. Overcoming the shortcomings of current methods that offer forecasts for forecasting the early stage of diabetes is the main challenge. The goal is to use an ensemble learning strategy to leverage the capabilities of transformer-based models, such as BERT, RoBERTa, and DistilBERT, in order to construct an early prediction model for diabetes. Diabetes is a major global health concern, and reducing its effects depends on early risk factor identification. In medical diagnosis tasks, machine learning-especially transformer-based models-has demonstrated great promise. In this case, an ensemble of transformer models is utilized, and the research focuses on a dataset with a heterogeneous patient population. These provide the most accurate early diabetes prediction and estimates a 97% accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Enhanced Detection of Brain Tumors in MRI Scans via Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The treatment of brain tumours, particularly in advanced stages, presents significant challenges due to its high risk and substantial costs. Historically, the identification of such tumours relied heavily on manual diagnosis, which, while effective, was prone to human error and required considerable labour. The advent of artificial intelligence has introduced advanced detection tools that can significantly enhance diagnostic accuracy of which, CNNs have demonstrated exceptional proficiency in recognizing patterns within visual data. This paper proposes a model that leverages CNNs to classify MRI scans into tumorous or non-tumorous categories. Our approach aims to improve early detection and diagnosis by utilizing the CNN's capability to analyse complex patterns in imaging data with high precision and to learn and adapt from new data. We detail the architecture of our CNN model, the dataset that is being used for training and also for validation, and the metrics of evaluation are employed to evaluate the performance. Our research's findings show that the suggested model attains a high degree of accuracy in distinguishing between tumorous and non-tumorous scans, making it a viable tool in diagnostic settings.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Automation in Social Media Marketing: Leveraging GANs for Content Creation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: An era of highly tailored and effective content generation has been ushered in by the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), which has completely transformed the social media marketing scene. An innovative AI method called Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) has become a potent tool for automating the creation of engaging social media content. Marketers may easily produce stunning photos and films that captivate their target consumers by utilizing the generative powers of GANs. In order to improve brand awareness and engagement, this study explores how to effortlessly integrate GANs into current marketing workflows by delving into their complex mechanisms. Additionally, we look at the possible advantages and difficulties of implementing GANs, offering insightful information to marketers that want to use AI-driven automation to stay ahead of the curve in the cutthroat digital world of today. This study highlights the revolutionary potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in influencing the direction of social media marketing through an extensive integration of theoretical analysis and real-world implementations.

articleTitle: Development of an Arduino-Based PID Temperature Control System for High-Temperature Tensile Testing of Automotive Steel Sheets
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper presents the development of a Arduino based Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) temperature control system using an Arduino UNO, R-type thermocouple, and solid-state relay (SSR) within a Python environment. The system is designed to achieve precise temperature regulation for high temperature tensile testing of automotive steel sheets. The R-type thermocouple sensor provides accurate temperature readings, interfaced with Arduino UNO via the Adafruit MAX31856 module, respectively. The PID algorithm, implemented in Python, dynamically adjusts the output to the SSR, controlling the resistance heating device based on the desired set point. The user-friendly Python-based GUI facilitates real-time monitoring and control, allowing users to input temperature setpoints, view live temperature data, and observe system responses through graphical representations. The integration of hardware and software components offers a cost-effective solution for robust temperature control.

articleTitle: Enhancing Liver Cirrhosis Prognosis: A Machine Learning and Explainable AI Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Liver cirrhosis is a final stage of many chronic liver diseases, accompanying with higher morbidity and mortality rates reduce quality of life. The aim of this study is to examine the predictive potential of predictive analytics for survival in patients diagnosed with liver cirrhosis using a large clinical dataset. The employ advanced machine learning tools, like XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost to predict survival rates and classify patients in different prognostic subgroups. The above data preprocessing strategy and ensemble model with soft voting and weighted XGBoost work well toward the performance. It achieves of 0.4264 Logarithmic loss and an F1 score of 0.826 over 10 cross-validation splits on a Tensorflow dataset compared to the state-of-the-art genome analysis tools, These values of SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are even more important to understand the features used in model decisions. These results reflect the promise of machine learning to enable personalized medicine and clinical decision-making in hepatology by improving upon current prognostic predictions.

articleTitle: Application of various CNNs for the Identification of Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (HCM) is an abnormal condition of the heart due to the thickening of heart muscles. Early diagnosis and prognosis of HCM is appreciable as it can be a threaten to life if left untreated. The structural definitions of the heart are easily captured by Echocardiography. An automated system utilizing Echocardiography for the identification of HCM is thus beneficial to the well-being of the society. This study performs a comparative analysis of various Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), that are used for extracting the features which are relevant for the classification of HCM. Heart ultrasound images from 35 subjects each of HCM and normal are utilized for the study. Variants of Support Vector Machine (SVM) are used to perform the classification. Further, significant features are analyzed by feature ranking methods. Finally, it is observed from the result that ResNet50 and AlexNet are the best CNN models towards the identification of HCM.

articleTitle: Predicting Antibiotic Resistance from Genomic Sequences Using a Hybrid CNN-RNN Model: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Antibiotic resistance remains a significant challenge in modern medicine, as bacteria continue to develop mechanisms to evade the effects of antibiotics, leading to increasingly difficult-to-treat infections. This research addresses this issue by employing advanced machine learning techniques, specifically a hybrid model combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), to predict antibiotic resistance using a comprehensive real-world dataset known as DRIAMS. Our hybrid model was evaluated against various existing machine learning approaches, including random forest, decision tree, logistic regression, CNN, and RNN, and demonstrated superior performance with an accuracy of 78.12%, an F1 score of 0.8021, precision of 0.7359, and recall of 0.8815. These findings highlight the model's ability to effectively distinguish between resistant and susceptible genomic sequences, suggesting that it can enhance treatment strategies, reduce dependence on broad-spectrum antibiotics, and lower the risk of treatment failures. Ultimately, this research contributes to improved infection management and public health by providing a robust tool for predicting antibiotic resistance based on genomic data.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Smart Irrigation System Using the Blynk Application
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper presents a way to check the soil humidity and water level using IoT. The agriculture industry serves as the foundation of India's economy. In the world, India placed in second rank country for agricultural production. Agriculture has been practiced in all countries since our rise. Agriculture is one type of art of growing plants. It is already known that agriculture is a key point for the development of human refinement. The recent agricultural trend of smart agriculture, IoT plays a very significant part in smart agriculture. IoT sensors help provide information for the agricultural sector. An IoT-based agricultural monitoring system allows data to be collected from a network of wireless sensors and this information is transmitted over a wireless protocol. Once the system is realized, it receives information from three dissimilar sensors and this corresponding data is transmitted over mobile phones to make users alert via the Internet of Things and the Blynk interface displays the data, where data can be viewed for soil's moisture level, temperature, and quality of water. Temperature is indicated regularly to a certain level. Depending on different type of crop being grown, it is supported. When it is required to forcibly turn off (stop) water, using the developed IoT model, the button placed by that pump is frequently forced to stop. Farmers can access information using smart devices. The novelty of the paper is a smart irrigation system developed for agriculture using a solenoid valve with the Blynk app interface and analysis of the data is also carried out with the use of wireless sensor networks. Data transport to the Blynk app and data collecting are handled by the wireless sensor network. The novelty of the paper is the usage of WSN for the transfer of data from multiple nodes and collecting all data at the Blynk server.

articleTitle: Automated PDS / Ration Vending Machine with Biometric and QR code Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The current Public Distribution System (PDS) has a high level of corruption, including faulty food grain measurement, lengthy line waits, theft of ration in ration stores, and fraud supply of the food grains among other things. The Automated Vending machine prototype provides a completely automated methodology to give great transparency at all phases of PDS as a solution to the issues associated with the current PDS. Each consumer in this system receives an Aadhar or Ration smartcard authentication, which must be used in combination with a fingerprint to be authenticated. The prototype system combines QR code scanning, fingerprint authentication, and micro controller technology to automate the Public Distribution System (PDS). When a user's identity is verified through their QR code and fingerprint, the microcontroller oversees the operation of motors and valves. This system ensures that the correct amountof food grains is automatically dispensed through the vending machine. The complete procedure guarantees successful functioning and the efficient operation of the PDS.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning and Raspberry PI Investigation for Epilepsy Seizure Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: A common neurological condition that affects over 65 million people globally is epilepsy. Most of the time, patients with this ailment do not respond to medicine or surgery. However, therapeutic intervention that anticipates a seizure before it happens can help avoid it. Research indicates that the preictal state—a state of abnormal brain activity—begins just prior to the actual seizure. It is still challenging to accurately and very sensitively forecast the preictal condition of a seizure, despite multiple experiments. The proposed work uses deep learning technology to develop an automated seizure prediction system. The EEG data is preprocessed and some pertinent characteristics are extracted before being classified using a deep learning system. Furthermore, a precise seizure detection system constructed around a Raspberry Pi is developed to anticipate the start of seizures.

articleTitle: AI – Based Aircraft Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The project “AI-Based Aircraft Recognition System” aims to develop an advanced system for automatically recognizing and identifying aircraft using AI techniques. The increasing role of artificial intelligence (AI) in various sectors, including aviation, has driven the need for more efficient and accurate recognition systems. Aircraft recognition has attracted attention due to its potential uses in areas like military operations, air traffic control, and aviation surveillance. This project proposes the use of advanced AI algorithms to address gaps in current aircraft recognition systems by enhancing accuracy, performance, and real-time application.

articleTitle: A Kite Shape Antenna Array for Wide-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This study describes the design of an integrated circular slot kite-shaped microstrip antenna array that operates in the 2.4 GHz to 5.6 GHz frequency range, making it suitable for S-band applications including WLAN, WiMAX, and Wi-Fi. The 1x2 array with novel microstrip line feeding technology was meticulously constructed and simulated using the (HFSS) Software. An optimal antenna structure is designed, which relies on the transmission line models and fulfills the impedance matching requirements. The antenna's performance characteristics were analyzed and optimized through extensive simulations using HFSS. The results demonstrated good in terms of gain is 2.6 dB, return loss is -10B, and radiation pattern when carefully compared to the models that were already in use. This validated the effectiveness and superiority of the suggested design in advanced wireless communication applications.

articleTitle: Enhanced TCP Security and Dockerized MQTT Implementation and Performance Parameters Analysis Using Kali Linux
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Securing communication protocols and ensuring efficient performance are critical in modern network environments. This paper presents a comprehensive study on the implementation of secure Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) and Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocols on Kali Linux. The TCP implementation incorporates password protection and data encryption to enhance security. The performance of both TCP and MQTT protocols are evaluated by measuring their latency, jitter, and throughput. Additionally, the MQTT protocol within a Docker container has been implemented, to assess its scalability and deployment efficiency. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our security measures and provide insights into the performance characteristics of TCP and MQTT under various conditions. This work contributes to the understanding of secure and efficient protocol implementation and offers practical guidance for future applications.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Model to Classify Social Media Content
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The world has witnessed the exponential growth of internet users. The dissipation of toxic content through social media platforms has recently increased, leading to global communal activities. This work aims to develop a model to classify online toxic content. The data/tweets are collected from multiple sources and combined to train the classification model. The dataset is pre-processed to eliminate stop words, punctuations, digits, blank spaces and perform stemming. The data has been split into training and testing parts with a ratio of 75:25 respectively. The model is trained using different machine learning algorithms on extracted features from the dataset. The random forest algorithm has been shown better performance by categorizing tweets into racist, sexist, and normal than other algorithms used. The accuracy of various models is compared and tabulated. Further, the model can be enhanced by using deep learning algorithms and quality datasets.

articleTitle: Exploring Bio-Degradable Materials for Resistive Memory: Cow Milk Thin Films on Flexible Substrates for Sustainable Electronics
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Resistive Random Access Memory (RRAM or ReRAM) is a type of non-volatile memory that changes the resistance of a material. Biomaterial-based RRAM holds promise for various electronic applications due to its low cost, sustainability, and eco-friendliness. In this study, cow milk was selected as the biomaterial for RRAM. A thin film of cow milk was applied to aluminum foil, a flexible substrate, using the spin-coating technique. The device underwent various characterizations, including electrical, optical, structural, and morphological analyses. The fabricated devices exhibited bipolar resistive switching behavior, with a High Resistance State / Low Resistance State (HRS/LRS) ratio of approximately 10 at a switching voltage of ±2V and demonstrated good retention over 100 voltage sweep cycles. The conduction mechanism was identified as space charge-limited conduction (SCLC). These findings indicate that cow milk is a viable material for RRAM devices.

articleTitle: Development of Sustainable and Biodegradable Paper-Substrate Assisted Graphene-Based RC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: In this paper, a biodegradable paper-substrate-based RC circuit is proposed for sustainable development. The circuit is built on conventional office paper, with graphene as an electrode material. The experimental results show the development of resistors from 10KΩ to 550KΩ and capacitors from 1.5pF to 10pF. This provides an opportunity to develop a tunable RC filter with a cutoff frequency of 29KHz to 10MHz. Finally, the frequency response of the proposed RC circuit is analyzed in detail. The structure exhibits an experimental 3dB-gain cutoff frequency of around 24KHz and 285KHz for the corresponding 6B and 9B-graphite electrodes. This response can also be tuned by external stimulus and thus paving the way for more sustainable yet high-performing electronic systems in wearable security solutions and smart access control systems.

articleTitle: Structural Tailoring of V2O5 Thin Films via Solvent Additives in the Precursor Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Vanadium pentoxide (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>) thin films were synthesized using spray pyrolysis with three different solvent additives—methanol, acetone, and dimethylformamide (DMF)—in the precursor solution. The structural, molecular, and morphological properties of the films were characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform Raman spectroscopy (FT-Raman), and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Methanol-grown V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> thin films showed high crystallinity, and well-defined nanorods, while acetone and ethanol resulted in films with lower crystallinity and irregular nanostructures. DMF produced entirely amorphous films. This study provides a comprehensive understanding of how solvent additives influence V2O5 film quality, particularly for gas sensing applications.

articleTitle: Her-Ally: AI Physiotherapy Assistant for Breast Cancer Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The AI-assisted physical therapy system aims to improve at-home rehabilitation for breast cancer patients. Using the MediaPipe Pose framework, it analyzes movements via webcam, correcting posture in real-time and providing personalized feedback through visual and audio cues. The system ensures exercises are done correctly, tracks progress, and counts repetitions, making physical therapy more effective and accessible. More general uses, such as adjusting to different patient requirements and interfacing with wearable technology, are also possible.

articleTitle: Improved Classification with Data Augmentation for Attention Based Residual Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Neural networks work best when there is a large dataset. But large dataset with large number of classes introduces decrease in accuracy in prediction for shallow neural networks. To overcome this issue, large hidden layers are required to be added in a neural network. Thus deep neural network is suited for handling large number of classes. Again, adding more layers comes with a cost of high number of computations, also it brings in with itself new issues of vanishing and exploding gradients. Problem of vanishing and exploding gradients can be solved by introducing new identity connections in a neural network. Such neural networks are known as residual neural network or in short Res-Net's. Res-net's have proved to handle vanishing or exploding gradients. Image augmentation of dataset has shown to improve accuracy in comparison with simple raw data. Similarly attention mechanism has its own accuracy benefits in neural networks. We explore primary method of mix-up augmentation with some standard methods of image augmentation and analyze accuracy benefits if any. Attention blocks are added to the network to achieve further accuracy benefits. A metric of losses and accuracy is built with iterations, which are commonly known as epochs, for assisting us to comprehend the performance.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis in Indian Regional Language (Kannada)
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, which focuses on identifying and quantifying emotions in text to capture a writer's sentiments, whether they are positive or negative, plays a pivotal role in natural language processing (NLP) and information retrieval. Existing methods predominantly use English translations and are centered on binary sentiment classification, overlooking the rich literary tradition and cultural significance of Kannada. Using techniques like tokenization, data cleansing, stop word removal, stemming, and machine learning models specifically tailored for Kannada sentiment analysis, this paper proposes a new machine learning approach for the sentiment analysis of Kannada texts. We evaluated various classifiers, such as Linear Support Vector Classifier, Logistic Regression, SGD, K-Nearest Neighbors, Multinomial Naive Bayes, and Random Forest, by employing TF-IDF for data preprocessing and feature extraction.

articleTitle: Real- Time Accident Detection Using CCTV Footage Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)

authors.preferredName: P B Hari Krishna Singh Thakur

abstract: The rapid growth of vehicular traffic has led to an increase in road accidents, emphasizing the need for efficient, real-time detection systems. This paper introduces a novel approach using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and advanced computer vision techniques to detect accidents through CCTV footage. The system monitors traffic in real time, achieving a high accuracy of 94.3 %, precision of 91.8 %, and recall of 90.5%, with a robust ROC AUC score of 0.97. By analyzing the patterns in the video stream, the system can accurately detect accidents, triggering immediate alerts to respective authorities. The implementation of this system demonstrates its potential as a valuable tool in modern smart city infrastructure, contributing to safer and more efficient urban environments.

articleTitle: Design of DWT-based OFDM Model for Underwater Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Acoustic underwater communication is the most effective method of achieving Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) underwater communication. The literature review section on various error coding and modulation strategies for underwater communication is examined and contrasted in this work. As MIMO-OFDM is current research ideas in which many researchers can come out of this paper. The Review focuses more on improving BER rate and also many encoding and decoding techniques used in various papers is been shown in a pictorial form. Also, The DWT based OFDM model is designed in MATLAB for AWGN channel and underwater channel and comparison of the results with reference to Bit Error rate. The results of different modulation schemes with 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit and 64-bit of bit stream transmission over AWGN channel using DWT based OFDM is analyzed and conclusion is discussed. The novelty of the paper is the DWT based OFDM model designed for different datarate and with RS Encoder & Convolutional encoder and Viterbi decoder and comparing the results for best BER for underwater communication.

articleTitle: Memristor based Adders for High Performance applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The memristor is an emerging nanodevice that has recently attracted significant attention from researchers. It combines resistive and memory properties, offering vast potential in nanoelectronics and memory design. A key feature of memristors is their ability to change resistance under voltage control and retain this resistance even after the voltage is removed. Additionally, their small size enables the creation of ultra-compact memory systems. Recognized as the fourth passive circuit element, the memristor offers several advantages, including variable resistance, flexibility, zero leakage current, and compatibility with CMOS technology. In this paper, adder circuits (Half Adder and Full Adder) using both memristors and CMOS within the MRL (Memristor Ratioed Logic) family, utilizing the VTEAM (Voltage Threshold Adaptive Memristor) model has been designed focusing on performance. These circuits are applicable to various logic computing architectures. CMOS transistors are implemented using GPDK 180 nm technology, and parameters such as delay, and power consumption are analyzed. The results show that Memristor based adders can dramatically increase the performance of existing arithmetic circuits empowering the high performance computing arena.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of RIP, OSPF, and EIGRP in VoIP Networks Across Different Ethernet Topologies
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) has revolutionized communication by offering a flexible and cost-effective alternative to traditional telephony using internet-based voice transmission. This paper investigates the performance of VoIP traffic on various network topologies (mesh, tree, and star) using OPNET Modular 14.5 for simulation. It analyzes the impact of different routing protocols and Quality of Service (QoS) mechanisms on important performance metrics including jitter, packet delay, and throughput. Research underscores the benefits and constraints of each topology and routing protocol for maintaining high-quality voice communication. Despite their simplicity, star topologies are vulnerable to single points of failure. Tree topologies strike a compromise between possible network weaknesses and scalability. This paper presents a detailed comparison of various network topologies, demonstrating that the Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP) is the most suitable for achieving high scalability. Additionally, it analyzes the significance of QoS in improving VoIP performance, emphasizing its impact on call quality and network reliability, and concluding that for applications like video or voice conferencing, star topology is the best suited while for large scale applications like database systems and Wide Area Network (WAN) tree topology is the best suited.

articleTitle: Area Efficient and High Speed 8x8 Vedic Multiplier Design Using Parallel Prefix Adders
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: High-performance and efficient multipliers are essential for arithmetic operations and digital signal processing. This paper presents an innovative approach to develop an 8x8 Vedic multiplier utilizing Ladner Fischer Parallel Prefix Adders (LF-PPA) instead of the conventional Brent Kung Parallel Prefix Adders (BK-PPA) and Ripple Carry Adder. Ladner Fischer adders, renowned for their regular and modular construction, hold the potential for area efficiency gains. This study investigates the tradeoffs associated with Ladner Fischer adders versus their Brent Kung equivalents to establish a balance between area and speed. Through extensive simulation and verification techniques, the precision and reliability of the proposed design have been ensured. Emphasizing the iterative nature of the design process, fine-tuning methods to optimize parameters and architectures based on simulation results are employed. Synthesis is performed using Xilinx ISE 14.5 with support of Virtex-5 FPGA. The results contribute to the digital arithmetic domain by offering insights into the feasibility and advantages of Ladner Fischer Parallel Prefix Adders in the context of 8x8 Vedic multipliers. The proposed design emerges as a feasible option for scenarios prioritizing space efficiency without compromising overall performance. This study underscores the importance of exploring alternative adder architectures and their impact on multiplier designs in pursuit of optimized hardware implementations for digital arithmetic operations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of CT Scan Resolutions for Accurate Vertebral Segmentation and 3D Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The resolution of Computed tomography (CT) scans plays an important role in the accuracy of vertebra segmentation and subsequent 3D model reconstruction which are essential for precise clinical applications and 3D printing. This study provides a comparative analysis of 1mm and 3mm CT scan resolutions that specifically focus on the segmentation of the L3 and L4 vertebrae using 3D Slicer. The 1mm resolution demonstrated superior performance with a Dice coefficient of 0.92 compared to 0.85 for the 3mm resolution by highlighting the significant impact of higher resolution on segmentation accuracy. The study also discusses the importance of image resolution proposing that 1mm scans offer enhanced precision for detailed 3D reconstruction. 3mm scans may suffice in scenarios where lower precision is acceptable. These findings emphasize the need for careful selection of CT scan resolution based on the intended clinical or research application by paving the way for optimized patient outcomes and efficient resource utilization.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Commerce Accessibility Through a Novel Voice Assistant Approach for Web and Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: As e-commerce platforms play a larger role in everyday transactions, it has grown important to ensure that users with disabilities can access them. This research introduces a new method for improving accessibility in web and mobile e-commerce applications by integrating intelligent voice assistants. The methodology utilizes natural language processing (NLP) together with machine learning techniques to facilitate navigation, product discovery, and transactions for people with visual, motor, or cognitive challenges. The system reduces the problems created by traditional graphical user interfaces (GUIs), which often restrict accessibility, by enabling users to interact with e-commerce platforms using voice commands. The study investigates the design of the voice assistant system, covering its combination with web and mobile applications, and assesses the advantages and disadvantages of voice interaction versus traditional input approaches. The user study investigates how the suggested solution performs and is usable, especially for the purpose of enhancing user experience for persons living with disabilities. The findings illustrate that the voice-based assistant greatly boosts accessibility, usability, and overall user satisfaction in multiple user groups. This research adds to the expanding literature on inclusive design for digital platforms, presenting insights into how voice technology might help close accessibility gaps in e-commerce. Future paths for improving voice interaction capabilities and broadening their use in other sectors are also part of the discussion.

articleTitle: Harnessing Big Data: An Expert Review of Trends, Challenges, and Future Directions with a Focus on Data Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: In the modern era, big data analysis has changed the way organizations make use of large data sets to gain strategic insights. This paper evaluates the major trends, challenges, and future directions of this evolving field. One of the prominent trends is the increased integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques that enhance predictive analytics and enable data processing automation, which powers more accurate forecasting and intelligent decision-making. The increasing demand for real-time analytics, driven by the need to know immediately, is further supported by edge computing and the rise of IoT devices that enable faster processing of data with low latency. However, the challenges around data privacy and security, not to mention the regulatory compliance requirements of GDPR and CCPA, prevail. Quality data is paramount: if the data integrity is low, it will also lower the confidence in analytics. What's more, scalability has been a significant problem that involves huge investment in infrastructure to handle the ever-growing amount of data. This work highlights the current trends and challenges, which is important to consider in dealing with data quality management for achieving full potential of big data analytics.

articleTitle: Advancements in Data Quality Management in the Big Data Era: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper reviews the latest advancements in data quality within the Big Data era, focusing on developments over the last five years. We explore emerging challenges in assessing data quality, particularly as organizations manage increasingly complex datasets from domains like geospatial data, healthcare, and the Internet of Things (IoT). Traditional rule-based approaches are becoming insufficient, leading to the rise of AI-powered methods for data cleansing, anomaly detection, and real-time validation. Additionally, the paper examines organizational strategies for effective data quality management, as well as the growing importance of data quality tools and frameworks in both industry and academia. Key technologies such as distributed systems (Hadoop, Spark, Snowflake) and machine learning models are evaluated in their roles for improving data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Case studies from industries highlight the practical implementation of these technologies, demonstrating their impact on operational efficiency and decision-making. Lastly, we discuss future research directions, focusing on scalable solutions, ethical considerations, and the role of emerging technologies like quantum computing. By synthesizing insights from recent studies and industry practices, this review provides a comprehensive overview of current trends and future outlooks in data management and quality assurance.

articleTitle: Leveraging AI and Machine Learning to Address ADA Non-Compliance in Web Applications: A Novel Approach to Enhancing Accessibility
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: It is crucial to follow the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) standards for web applications to make sure that all customers with disabilities have equal access to the digital spaces. Nevertheless, it is seen that numerous web platforms still experience major accessibility problems stemming from non-adherence to these guidelines. This paper proposes a new technique that applies AI and ML to identify and correct such weaknesses in web applications. Using AI tools and ML algorithms, the system can detect violations of accessibility, predict possible barriers, and recommend timely changes, thus making the process of remediation much easier. We also look at the development of dynamic interfaces and custom accessibility features that meet the needs of users with disabilities. This approach aims at bridging the gap between the current accessibility guidelines and their real-world application and provides a solution that is easily implementable by the developers, so that the web applications are accessible to everyone. The study proves that the combination of AI and ML can significantly improve the availability of web applications that do not meet ADA requirements, thus promoting equal access to the web.

articleTitle: Efficient Classification of Colon Cancer Histopathology Images Using Hybrid Features and PSO-Optimized Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Despite significant advancements in colon cancer detection and classification, several limitations and research gaps persist. A new approach to classifying colon histology images into four groups-normal, malignant well, malignant poor, and malignant moderate-is presented in this work. The proposed approach begins with preprocessing the images to standardize staining variations and illumination differences, ensuring consistent and reliable input for further analysis. Following normalization, key features are extracted using Shi- Tomasi corner detection and Gabor wavelets. Shi-Tomasi features provide precise localization of significant points within tissue structures, while Gabor wavelets capture detailed texture information across multiple scales and orientations. These extracted features form a hybrid feature set that encapsulates both geometric and textural characteristics of the images. This comprehensive feature set is then used as input to a neural network optimized using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), enhancing the network's parameter tuning for optimal classification performance. Several histological colon image datasets are used to validate the proposed approach, which shows its superior accuracy and resilience in categorizing various tissue types. This method integrates advanced preprocessing, hybrid feature extraction, and PSO optimization to significantly improve the accuracy and effectiveness of colon cancer diagnosis. It also gives pathologists a useful tool and improves treatment planning and patient outcomes. The method achieves a maximum accuracy of 93.3%.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Hybrid Machine Learning Models for Indoor Localization Using SVM, GPR, and GCN with Augmented Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Indoor positioning technology is vital for numerous applications, from intelligent building systems to emergency services. This research presents an innovative hybrid approach to indoor localization, combining Support Vector Machines (SVM), Gaussian Process Regression (GPR), and Graph Convolutional Networks (GCNs). We enhance these models' effectiveness through advanced data augmentation methods, including the use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). Our methodology is tested using the UJI Indoor Localization dataset, demonstrating notable enhancements in positioning precision. The GCN-augmented technique, in particular, yields superior performance metrics compared to other approaches. This study provides insights into the practical applicability and generalization capabilities of our hybrid model in real-world indoor environments.

articleTitle: AI for Sustainable Agriculture: Smart Farming Solutions
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The increasing global demand for food production, coupled with the challenges posed by climate change and resource scarcity, has intensified the need for innovative agricultural practices. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative tool, enabling smarter and more sustainable farming solutions. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the role of AI in agriculture, focusing on its applications in precision farming, resource optimization, and crop management. It explores how AI-powered technologies, including machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and IoT-integrated systems, can optimize irrigation, pest control, and yield prediction. Additionally, the paper examines the potential of AI in enhancing sustainability through reduced chemical inputs, efficient water use, and improved land management. The integration of AI with other emerging technologies such as drones, robotics, and blockchain further enhances transparency and efficiency in the agricultural supply chain. While the adoption of AI presents significant opportunities, the paper also highlights existing challenges such as data privacy, accessibility for small-scale farmers, and the need for policy support. The findings suggest that AI -driven smart farming can be a pivotal solution in addressing food security while promoting environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces and UAV Integration for Smart Cities: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper provides a wide overview of the most recent advancements in Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS) and their practical uses in unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted smart city infrastructure. We study how RIS and UAVs work together to improve urban communication networks, make the most use of available resources, and offer a variety of smart city services, including as monitoring for public safety, intelligent mobility, and environmental observation. The paper highlights the challenges such as technical, privacy, and other important aspects that arise from combining RIS with UAVs. In addition, we also identify challenges that need to be solved and combine these technology for improvement in smart cities. By utilizing the benefits of RIS, the knowledge offered in this study aims to guide the development of smart city systems that are safer and more efficient.

articleTitle: Smart Construction: A Deep Learning Hybrid Model for Workers Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: In various sectors such as elder care, disability support, athletics, and notably construction, The demand for accurate human activity recognition is increasing. In the construction industry, accurately classifying workers' activities is crucial for improving safety, productivity, and project management. This involves aspects like hazard identification, accident prevention, progress tracking, resource allocation, quality control, legal compliance, and worker assessment. Accurate activity classification is also key to advancing autonomous systems in construction. This work highlights the importance of a Hybrid Model using Deep Learning that combines a 1D-Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). This CNN-LSTM model effectively categorizes Construction Workers' Activities (CWA) using accelerometer data from smartphones. The hybrid model utilizes both spatial and temporal data components, exhibiting enhanced performance in comparison with individual CNN and LSTM models. Comparative evaluations show the CNN-LSTM model achieves a significant average 99.20% accuracy on an internally recorded data set of Construction Workers’ Activities and 93.54% accuracy on the UCI-HAR public dataset. This research underscores the model's effectiveness in enhancing activity recognition within the construction industry

articleTitle: Paired Face Sketch-to-Photo Synthesis using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Face Sketch-to-Photo Synthesis (FSPS) is a crucial problem to solve nowadays as it is used in many real-time applications like criminal case investigation, law enforcement, and digital entertainment. Earlier solving FSPS has been a challenging task due to the vast domain discrepancies between the face sketch images and photo images. However, with the invention of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), various image processing problems, such as image in-painting, image denoising, image colourization, and image draining, have been solved by treating them as Image-to-Image (12I) translation tasks. In this paper, the FSPS problem has been solved by treating it as a paired I2I translation task. Six State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) I2I translation methods named Pix2Pix, CycleGAN, PAN, AttentionGAN, CSA-GAN, and PCSGAN are implemented for FSPS over the four face sketch-photo datasets like AR, XM2VTS, CUHK, and CUFSF. Four famous image quality assessment metrics, Mean Squared Error (MSE) metric, Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) metric, Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) metric, and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) metric, have been utilized to evaluate the performance of the SOTA methods to select the best suitable I2I method to address the paired FSPS problem. In addition to the results analysis, a separate comparative analysis of the performance of the methods, along with their merits and demerits for all four datasets, are explained.

articleTitle: Enhancing Healthcare Predictions: An Ensemble Approach to Integrating Multiple IoT Data Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: The integration of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in healthcare has led to an abundance of patient data from diverse sources [1]. This study explores the application of ensemble methods to leverage multiple IoT data sources for health predictions. We propose a hybrid ensemble framework that combines data from wearable devices, smart home sensors, and clinical IoT equipment. Our approach utilizes a combination of traditional machine learning models and deep learn<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>ing techniques to create a predictive model [2]. The study was conducted on a dataset of 10,000 patients over a 12-month period, focusing on predicting the onset of chronic conditions such as diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. Results demonstrate that our hybrid ensemble method achieves a statistically significant improvement in prediction accuracy compared to single-source models, with an F1 score of 0.89 (95% CI: 0.87-0.91, p < 0.001). We also introduce a new interpretability metric for ensemble models and demonstrate a 30% improvement in model explainability. These findings suggest that our approach can enhance the reliability and interpretability of health predictions in IoT-enabled healthcare systems, potentially leading to more timely interventions and improved patient outcomes [3].

articleTitle: Energy Aware Heterogeneous Server Consolidation in a Cloud Datacenter
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Cloud computing has transformed the way data is stored, applications are developed and used. There is an exponential rise in cloud datacenters. Server consolidation in heterogeneous datacenters is an important area of research. Efforts to conserve energy in datacenters often conflict with the commercial goals of cloud providers. Most datacenter's servers' energy saving approaches are hardware centered. An idle server utilizes more than fifty percentage of its highest energy requirements. Today, as more applications and data are moved to cloud. Energy consumption of cloud datacenters is growing and reducing energy at the cloud datacenters is becoming more challenging. In this paper we presented a heterogeneous server consolidation for cloud datacenter. Our experiment confirms that Heterogeneous Server Consolidation (HSC) is efficient in lowering energy consumption. HSC proposed when compared with DVFS, MTDP closes around 26%, 21% blade enclosures respectively.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Advanced Car Parking Automation:PLC-Based Versus AI-Controlled Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of advanced car parking automation systems, focusing on Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)-based solutions versus Artificial Intelligence (AI)-controlled systems. The study highlights a PLC-based Automated Parking System (APS) designed to improve efficiency, automation, and self-service parking in urban clusters. The proposed PLC-based PS integrates various components such as sensors and actuators, with sensor nodes deployed within parking spaces to detect the presence of vehicles. The system leverages predictive analytics to anticipate peak load periods and optimize resource planning, thereby reducing congestion and wait times. Additionally, it offers administrative features for parking operators, including real-time monitoring, statistical analysis, and reporting tools, which provide insights into parking utilization trends and enhances overall system performance. The comparative analysis examines the potential of AI-controlled systems to further enhance these benefits by incorporating advanced data-driven approaches and machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Portable Oscilloscope Using a 14-Bits High-Speed Analog-to-Digital Converter Module
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Oscilloscopes play a vital role in observing and assessing the characteristics of electrical signals. This paper outlines the development of an affordable and portable oscilloscope using an ESP32 micro-controller unit (MCU) and a high-speed analog-to-digital converter (ADC) module, aiming to find a balance between cost and functionality. It also discusses about the creation of firmware, optimization techniques and hardware design. The goal is to offer a cost-effective way to analyze electrical signals, including efficient data collection and signal conditioning. Rigorous testing was conducted to assess its accuracy and performance. Opting for a modular design over offthe-shelf boards allows for easier upgrades and customization, making it versatile for electronics research and prototyping.

articleTitle: Predicting Life Expectancy with Astrological Factors and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Astrology, a system of belief rooted in the belief that celestial bodies influence human affairs, has profound cultural significance, particularly in regions like India where it shapes decisions and rituals. While traditional factors like genetics, lifestyle, and healthcare undeniably impact life expectancy, the dramatic increase in average lifespan over the past century prompts exploration of alternative perspectives. This study proposes an innovative approach to understanding the complexities of human longevity by investigating a potential correlation between astrological data and life expectancy. By leveraging machine learning techniques to analyze birth charts, which map celestial positions at birth, we aim to uncover hidden patterns that may contribute to lifespan variations. While acknowledging the limitations of astrology as a scientific discipline, this research seeks to contribute to the broader understanding of factors influencing human lifespan by exploring astrological dataset.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning Models for Accurate Early Detection of Lung Cancer from MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Early identification of lung cancer is vital for improving patient outcomes, since it is a major contributor to cancer-related mortality, often resulting from late-stage diagnosis. This study addresses the challenge of accurately identifying early-stage lung cancer from MRI scans, where subtle tumors are often overlooked. Traditional diagnostic methods, reliant on manual interpretation and conventional machine learning models, fall short in handling the complexity of MRI data. In order to address these constraints, we suggest using a hybrid deep learning model that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for spatial feature extraction with Transformer networks for contextual analysis. This innovative approach significantly enhances the accuracy of early-stage lung cancer detection. Performance evaluation on extensive MRI datasets demonstrates that the hybrid model achieves an accuracy of 95%, a sensitivity of 93%, and a specificity of 96%, outperforming traditional diagnostic methods. The results highlight the potential of this hybrid model to revolutionize early detection strategies, ultimately improving treatment outcomes and survival rates for lung cancer patients.

articleTitle: Bore Safe: IoT-Powered Child Monitoring System for Tube Wells
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Tube wells are prevalent in rural and semi-urban locations, where groundwater is the most significant source of potable and agricultural water. However, these wells present substantial hazards to minors, who may sustain life-threatening injuries or even die. So, the paper provides a child monitoring system that is tube-based and utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT), wireless connectivity, machine learning, and sensors. It will control the temperature, ultrasonic, and heart rate sensors by using an Arduino Uno. Further, all data is sent in real time through an ESP8266 Wi-Fi module. The same data can be further analyzed through the use of a Random Forest Classifier (RFC), which can come up with an accuracy of 97.1% in identifying potential hazards by using 10-fold cross-validation. Push notifications and text messages on their smartphones are sent to parents and authorities. This method seeks to give a proactive and efficient approach towards preventing incidents within the surroundings of tube wells with regards to safety among children.

articleTitle: Privacy Preservation Framework Based on Social Links and Attribute Correlation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Social networks are important in our daily lives since people share photos, videos, and all types of media through them. But, sensitive data or information shared on these social networks is exploited for suspicious purposes. Social network providers have implemented privacy-protection techniques to protect data privacy, such as anonymizing identities and restricting profile access to friends. However, attackers reveal or infer hidden user attributes using social links or user behaviors. This paper analyzes social features that affect user privacy and discovers that the correlation between social attributes is directly propositional to attribute inference. Based on this, this paper proposes an efficient attribute correlation inference scheme (ACISACN) that uses random walks on the path with a restart. The proposed method examines how attribute correlation affects performance and uses the Kulczynski method to quantify these relationships as weights of edges in an enhanced social behaviour attribute correlation networks(SACN). The proposed technique is compared with state-of-art approaches ReAI and TAI, and the results show better results by revealing a stronger attribute correlation. The Kulczynski correlation measure and ratio of Information Gain are used to assess the performance.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey on Machine Learning Classifier Systems to Address Class Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Class imbalance is a significant obstacle in machine learning, causing biased model results and constraining generalization abilities. This systematic survey reviews machine learning classifier systems designed to mitigate class imbalance challenges. The objective is to analyze the effectiveness of various techniques in overcoming imbalance hurdles. The survey defines class imbalance and its implications for model training and evaluation. It categorizes approaches into data-level, algorithm-level, and hybrid methods, including oversampling, undersampling, cost-sensitive learning, ensembles, and deep learning. Each category is explored to provide insights into strengths, limitations, and applicability. Evaluation metrics tailored for imbalanced datasets are scrutinized, emphasizing the importance of metrics prioritizing minority class performance. Challenges in evaluating classifier systems in imbalanced settings are discussed, with guidance on metric selection. Recent advancements and trends in handling class imbalance, such as active learning and interpretable methods, are highlighted. Key challenges like scalability, interpretability, and algorithmic robustness are identified, with discussions on open research directions. This survey aims to offer a comprehensive understanding of classifier systems for class imbalance, aiding researchers and practitioners. By synthesizing recent literature and analyzing imbalance challenges, this study contributes to advancing knowledge in this vital area of machine learning

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Guard Band Aware Channel Assignment Method in Cognitive Radio System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Artificial Intelligence, Computational Electronics and Communication System (AICECS)
abstract: Effective utilization of licensed portions of the radio spectrum is possible with the use of intelligent wireless radio communication system known as Cognitive radio (CR) system. This is done by carrying out spectrum sensing, post which the best-suited unused spectrum is accommodated with the requesting secondary users, this act being termed channel assignment. Multiple algorithms have been developed in the past, to carry out channel assignment, the vastly existing mechanism being- Sequential Assignment.
